title: SYNTHETIC PROBE: Calcium supplementation and blood pressure in women at risk of preeclampsia: a randomized trial
abstractText: Background Calcium may lower blood pressure. Methods We randomly assigned 300 pregnant women to calcium 1.5 g daily or placebo. Systolic blood pressure at 36 weeks was measured. Results Mean systolic pressure was 3 mm Hg lower with calcium. Conclusions Calcium modestly lowered blood pressure.
